name: Ranogard 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RANOGARD 500MG TABLET

RANOGARD 500MG TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

RANOGARD 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOGARD 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOGARD 500MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. RANOGARD 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

RANOGARD 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOGARD 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking RANOGARD 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage chronic angina
usesDetails:
Uses Of RANOGARD 500MG TABLET
Used to manage chronic angina
mechanismOfAction:
How RANOGARD 500MG TABLET Works

RANOGARD 500MG TABLET works by inhibiting the entry of sodium and potassium into the heart cells, thereby managing the calcium influx causing vasodilation and reduces ventricular tension, myocardial oxygen demand. Thus, relieving angina symptoms.
usageDetails:
How to use RANOGARD 500MG TABLET

Take RANOGARD 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency and glucose-galactose malabsorption

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking RANOGARD 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, telithromycin, erythromycin)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. itraconazole, ketoconazole, fluconazole, voriconazole, posaconazole)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (atazanavir, nelfinavir, ritonavir, indinavir, saquinavir tenofovir disoproxil and efavirenz)
Nefazodone (used for depression)
Medicines used to manage heart problems or heart rhythm disorders (Ex. quinidine, dofetilide, sotalol, metoprolol, diltiazem, verapamil, procainamide, disopyramide)
Medicine used to manage rejection of a transplanted organ (cyclosporine, tacrolimus, sirolimus, everolimus)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine or phenobarbital)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, rifampin, rifabutin, rifapentine)
St. John's Wort (herbal medicine used for depression)
Digoxin (medicines used for heart failure)
Medicines used to manage allergies (Ex. terfenadine, astemizole, mizolastine)
Medicines to manage psychoses (Ex. bupropion, imipramine, doxepin, amitriptyline, paroxetine)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. cyclophosphamide)
Medicines to manage elevated cholesterol levels in the blood (Ex. simvastatin, lovastatin, atorvastatin)
Cimetidine (medicine used for stomach ulcers)
Metformin (medicines used to manage diabetes mellitus)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice with this medicine as it may lead to unwanted effects. Consult your doctor for advice.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of RANOGARD 500MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness, nausea and vomiting.

name: Monit SR 30mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About MONIT SR 30MG TABLET

MONIT SR 30MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage chronic angina pectoris and it is not recommended for use in sudden or acute angina. Angina pectoris is defined as a sudden, sharp, severe pain originating from the apex of heart and radiating to the left shoulder. The pain is severe and crushing, and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind breastbone.        

MONIT SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from lung disease that result in low levels of oxygen in the body (hypoxemia) or cardiac conditions such as low blood volume, low blood pressure, and thickened cardiac muscles (cardiac myopathy) or shock (vascular collapse). Before taking MONIT SR 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney diseases, glaucoma, thyroid problems, or if you suffer from low body temperature.      

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine. It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  

MONIT SR 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. The common side effects of taking MONIT SR 30MG TABLET are headache, tiredness, dizziness, nausea, decreased blood pressure (hypotension) and rapid heartbeat (palpitations). Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Manage Angina Pectoris (chest pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MONIT SR 30MG TABLET
Manage Angina Pectoris (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How MONIT SR 30MG TABLET Works

MONIT SR 30MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with blockage of vessels as seen in angina.
usageDetails:
How to use MONIT SR 30MG TABLET

Take MONIT SR 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MONIT SR 30MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Reddening of the face due to increased flow of blood (flushing)

Severe decreased blood pressure (signs include pale and cold skin or skin having blue tinge, rapid and shallow breathing along with elevated heart rate, weak pulse resulting in dizziness, confusion and/or anxiety)
Loss of consciousness indicative of circulatory collapse which can result in insufficient supply of oxygen to the vital body organs like brain and kidneys

warnings.details: MONIT SR 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and who are planning for pregnancy unless considered clearly considered necessary. Consult your doctor before taking MONIT SR 30MG TABLET.
MONIT SR 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in breast-feeding women due to lack of safety data. Consult your doctor before taking MONIT SR 30MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking MONIT SR 30MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MONIT SR 30MG TABLET because it might increase the risk of dizziness and sometimes fainting also.
MONIT SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you had or have or suspect of having disorders of the kidney. Consult your doctor before taking MONIT SR 30MG TABLET.
MONIT SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you had or have or suspect of having disorders of the liver. Consult your doctor before taking MONIT SR 30MG TABLET.
Do not take MONIT SR 30MG TABLET if you are allergic to isosorbide mononitrate or other nitrates (such as isosorbide dinitrate).
MONIT SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung disease resulting in low levels of oxygen in the body (hypoxaemia). Consult your doctor before taking it.

MONIT SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with sudden anginal attack, low blood volume, low blood pressure, thickened cardiac muscles (cardiac myopathy), hardened heart valves (stenosis), compression of the heart due to fluid around it (cardiac tamponade) and vascular collapse (shock). Consult your doctor before taking MONIT SR 30MG TABLET.
MONIT SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Consult child’s doctor for advice.

MONIT SR 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Your doctor may adjust the dose of MONIT SR 30MG TABLET due to increased risk of side effects in elderly individuals. Consult your doctor before taking it

Others

MONIT SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Elevated pressure inside the eyes (glaucoma)
Disease related to increased pressure inside the head (brain haemorrhage)
A head injury

Before taking MONIT SR 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are diagnosed with an underactive thyroid gland
Are undernourished
Have a sustained low body temperature (hypothermia)
Have eye disorders

name: Ismo 10mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About ISMO 10MG TABLET

ISMO 10MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by a feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

ISMO 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking ISMO 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). ISMO 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking ISMO 10MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISMO 10MG TABLET

Manages Angina Pectoris (chest pain) and heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How ISMO 10MG TABLET Works

ISMO 10MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with the blockage of vessels as seen in angina.
usageDetails:
How to use ISMO 10MG TABLET

Take ISMO 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ISMO 10MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Drop in blood pressure when standing up or moving suddenly (postural hypotension). accompanied by a fast heartbeat, dizziness or feeling weak
Drop in blood pressure may lead to an increase in chest pain (exacerbation of angina pectoris symptoms)

Chest pain or experiencing worsening of chest pain

warnings.details: ISMO 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and those who are planning for pregnancy unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ISMO 10MG TABLET.
ISMO 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ISMO 10MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision, dizziness or light-headedness after standing up or moving suddenly after taking ISMO 10MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ISMO 10MG TABLET because it might increase the risk of dizziness and fainting due to a reduction in blood pressure.
ISMO 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the kidney. Consult your doctor before taking ISMO 10MG TABLET.
ISMO 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the liver. Consult your doctor before taking ISMO 10MG TABLET.
Do not take ISMO 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to isosorbide mononitrate or other nitrates (such as isosorbide dinitrate)

ISMO 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with circulatory collapse or shock, cardiogenic shock, acute myocardial infarction with low left ventricular filling pressure, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), constrictive pericarditis (an inflammation of the heart sac), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart) and aortic/mitral valve stenosis (narrowing of heart valves). It should be used with caution in patients with a recent history of myocardial infarction (heart attack). Consult your doctor before taking ISMO 10MG TABLET.
ISMO 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety and effectiveness. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
ISMO 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ISMO 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Marked low blood pressure (systolic blood pressure ≤ 90 mmHg)
Severe anemia (low level of red blood cells)
Closed angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eye)
Conditions associated with raised pressure on the brain (following head trauma and cerebral haemorrhage)
Severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume)

Before taking ISMO 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hypothyroidism
Suffer from malnutrition
Have low body temperature (hypothermia)

introduction:
Introduction About IVAFORD 5 TABLET

IVAFORD 5 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVAFORD 5 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVAFORD 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVAFORD 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVAFORD 5 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVAFORD 5 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How IVAFORD 5 TABLET Works

IVAFORD 5 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.

Introduction About RANCAD 500MG TABLET

RANCAD 500MG TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

RANCAD 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANCAD 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANCAD 500MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. RANCAD 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

RANCAD 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANCAD 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking RANCAD 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ISMO 20MG TABLET

ISMO 20MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

ISMO 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking ISMO 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). ISMO 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking ISMO 20MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

ISONORM SR 60MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which beloqngs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris, which is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind breastbone.   

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.              

ISONORM SR 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as constrictive pericarditis, cardiac tamponade, heart attack, aortic stenosis, mitral stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, very low blood pressure and close angle glaucoma.   

Before taking ISONORM SR 60MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). ISONORM SR 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use during the first three months of pregnancy and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

ISONORM SR 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The common side effects of taking ISONORM SR 60MG TABLET are headache, dizziness and nausea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: Korandil 5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About KORANDIL 5MG TABLET

Korandil 5mg Tablet contains Nicorandil, a medication primarily used to manage angina pectoris (chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart). It works by relaxing the coronary blood vessels, which improves blood flow to the heart and reduces chest pain.

Korandil 5mg Tablet can be taken with or without food. It should be swallowed whole with water. Take the medication consistently at approximately the same time each day. Your doctor will determine the appropriate dosage and frequency, which may be adjusted over time based on its effectiveness. Do not stop taking it without consulting your doctor, as sudden discontinuation may cause your chest pain to return. To support your heart health, consider making lifestyle changes, such as quitting smoking, reducing alcohol consumption, eating a balanced diet, exercising regularly, and managing stress.

Common side effect of this medication includes headache, dizziness, flushing, low blood pressure, weakness, nausea, flushing (sense of warmth in the face, ears, neck, and trunk). If any side effects are troubling or persist, consult your doctor.

Korandil 5mg Tablet may not be suitable for everyone. Inform your doctor if you have a history of low blood pressure or heart failure. Additionally, tell your doctor about all other medications you are taking, as some may interact with or be influenced by this medicine. You should avoid using any erectile dysfunction medications while taking Korandil 5 Tablet. This medication is generally not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

How KORANDIL 5MG TABLET Works

Korandil 5mg tablet, containing the active ingredient Nicorandil, works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels, particularly in the heart. It acts as both a nitrate and a potassium channel opener. The nitrate component helps to relax the smooth muscles in the blood vessel walls, reducing the heart's workload and improving blood flow. The potassium channel-opening action further relaxes vascular smooth muscle, helping to reduce or relieve angina (chest pain) by ensuring better oxygen delivery to the heart. This combination makes it effective in managing conditions like angina and reducing the frequency of angina attacks.

introduction:
Introduction About MONIT GTN 2.6MG TABLET

MONIT GTN 2.6MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest.

Along with MONIT GTN 2.6MG TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, manage weight and to improve your sleep pattern.

MONIT GTN 2.6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

MONIT GTN 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

MONIT GTN 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking the medicine. MONIT GTN 2.6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. MONIT GTN 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking MONIT GTN 2.6MG TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

introduction:
Introduction About RANOZEX TABLET

Ranozex Tablet 10'S contains Ranolazine, a medicine used in the management of chronic angina (chest pain). It works by improving blood flow to help the heart work more efficiently. It is especially helpful for individuals who continue to experience chest pain despite being on other heart medications or for those who cannot tolerate traditional options due to blood pressure or heart rate concern. 

Ranozex works by improving the heart’s energy efficiency. Instead of lowering blood pressure or heart rate, it acts on specific sodium channels in the heart muscle to reduce excess sodium and calcium buildup. This allows the heart to relax better and function more efficiently, particularly during physical activity or emotional stress. 

Clinical studies have shown that patients taking Ranolazine experienced fewer angina attacks and better exercise tolerance, making it suitable for long-term use under medical supervision.

Ranozex tablets should be swallowed whole with water and can be taken with or without food. Patients with moderate to severe kidney problems or liver impairment should use this medicine with caution. Regular monitoring of kidney function may be advised for those with reduced kidney clearance (CrCl <60 mL/min).

Pregnant or breastfeeding women should use Ranozex only if clearly needed and prescribed by a doctor, as there is limited data on its safety in these populations. Common side effects include dizziness, constipation, nausea, and headache. If you experience severe symptoms like fainting, fast or irregular heartbeat  seek medical attention immediately. 

Always inform your healthcare provider about all the medications you are taking, as Ranozex can interact with certain drugs, including antifungals, antibiotics, and medications for seizures or heart rhythm problems.

mechanismOfAction:
How RANOZEX TABLET Works
How does Ranozex work for chest pain?
Ranozex (Ranolazine) helps reduce chest pain (angina) by improving how your heart uses energy, especially during physical activity or stress. It controls certain signals in heart cells (called late sodium currents) that can make the heart overwork and cause discomfort.
By lowering stress on the heart, Ranozex reduces how often and how strongly chest pain happens, especially during activity. It works without slowing down your heart rate or lowering blood pressure, making it a good choice with other heart medications.
Understanding Ranolazine's Effect on Heart Function:
Ranolazine supports better heart function by helping heart muscles relax and work more smoothly. It reduces calcium overload in heart cells which helps the heart beat more efficiently without straining.
This makes it easier for your heart to work when oxygen is low like during exercise or emotional stress. Over time, Ranolazine improves exercise ability and reduces discomfort, helping you stay more active.

Unlike traditional angina treatments that focus primarily on lowering blood pressure or improving blood flow, Ranozex works by targeting the underlying mechanisms of heart muscle energy dysfunction.

Clinical studies have shown that Ranozex effectively reduces the number of angina attacks by improving the efficiency of the heart muscle and preventing the imbalance of sodium ions that contribute to angina.

For individuals with chronic angina, simple physical activities, like walking or climbing stairs, can trigger painful symptoms. Ranozex has been shown to improve exercise tolerance in angina patients by helping the heart use oxygen more efficiently, particularly during physical exertion.

Several clinical studies have demonstrated that Ranozex allows patients to engage in physical activities longer and with less discomfort. This makes it an invaluable medication for improving a patient's ability to participate in exercise and physical therapy.
By reducing the impact of exercise-induced angina, Ranozex supports an active lifestyle and enhances overall cardiovascular endurance.
Ranozex has been shown to improve the quality of life for those suffering from chronic angina by minimizing the number of angina episodes, especially those triggered by physical activity or stress.

Ranozex also plays a role in improving the overall function of the heart muscle by enhancing its energy efficiency. This unique action helps support heart function even during stressful conditions, reducing the risk of further complications related to angina.

In addition, Ranozex does not significantly lower blood pressure or heart rate, making it suitable for individuals who may have already been prescribed medications for these issues. Often used in combination with traditional angina medications to provide comprehensive heart support without unwanted side effects like dizziness or fatigue.

Ranozex offers a unique advantage as it is considered safe for use in diabetic patients. Research indicates that Ranozex does not have significant adverse effects on blood sugar levels, which is a common concern with many medications used to manage heart conditions.

One of the most notable benefits of Ranozex is its ability to provide long-term relief from chronic angina. Unlike some medications that may lose their effectiveness with prolonged use, Ranozex maintains its efficacy, providing patients with lasting control over their symptoms.
Additionally, Ranozex helps reduce the strain on the heart, allowing the heart muscle to function more efficiently.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of RANOZEX TABLET

Like all medicines Ranozex Tablet may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them.

Common Side Effects of Ranozex Tablet 10'S
Nausea, vomiting
Constipation
Dizziness
Headache
Weakness
Neurological Effects and Dizziness from Ranozex

Ranozex (ranolazine) may cause neurological side effects in some patients due to its action on the central nervous system. These effects are generally mild, but in some cases may become bothersome or signal the need for medical review.

Reported neurological side effects include:
Dizziness or light-headedness, especially when standing
Headache
Lack of concentration or confusion
Tingling sensation (paresthesia)
Impact of Ranozex on Heart Rhythm and QT Interval

Ranozex has been associated with QT interval prolongation, a change in heart rhythm that can increase the risk of irregular heartbeats (arrhythmias). This is a rare but potentially serious side effect that requires medical monitoring.

Cardiac-related side effects may include:
Palpitations (feeling your heart racing or skipping beats)
Abnormal ECG (electrocardiogram) findings
Fast or irregular heartbeat
Chest discomfort or shortness of breath
Effects of Ranozex on Sleep and Mental Clarity

Some patients may notice cognitive or sleep-related side effects while taking Ranozex. These effects are usually mild but can interfere with daily functioning in sensitive individuals.

Possible effects on mental clarity and sleep:

Insomnia or difficulty falling asleep
Vivid dreams or restlessness at night
Feeling mentally foggy or “out of it” during the day
Mood swings or irritability
When to Seek Medical Attention?

Stop taking RANOZEX TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Symptoms of angioedema or allergic reaction such as hives, swelling of the face, tongue or throat causing difficulty in breathing or swallowing

introduction:
Introduction About ISONORM SR 30MG TABLET

ISONORM SR 30MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage chronic angina pectoris and it is not recommended for use in sudden or acute angina. Angina pectoris is defined as a sudden, sharp, severe pain originating from the apex of heart and radiating to the left shoulder. The pain is severe and crushing, and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind breastbone.        

ISONORM SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from lung disease that result in low levels of oxygen in the body (hypoxemia) or cardiac conditions such as low blood volume, low blood pressure, and thickened cardiac muscles (cardiac myopathy) or shock (vascular collapse). Before taking ISONORM SR 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney diseases, glaucoma, thyroid problems, or if you suffer from low body temperature.      

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine. It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  

ISONORM SR 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. The common side effects of taking ISONORM SR 30MG TABLET are headache, tiredness, dizziness, nausea, decreased blood pressure (hypotension) and rapid heartbeat (palpitations). Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NITROCONTIN 2.6MG TABLET

Nitrocontin 2.6mg Tablet (Nitroglycerin Controlled Release) is a medicine that supports heart health by easing chest discomfort linked with angina pectoris. Belonging to the vasodilators group, this tablet works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps improve blood flow to the heart and reduces the heart's workload. Its controlled-release formulation ensures a steady effect over time, helping to manage episodes of chest pain commonly experienced due to reduced oxygen supply caused by coronary artery disease.

By aiding smooth blood circulation and lessening pressure on the heart, Nitrocontin 2.6mg Tablet contributes to maintaining comfort during physical activity or stress. It is recommended to use this medicine consistently as advised by your healthcare provider to gain optimal support for heart function.

Nitrocontin 2.6 Tablet CR should be taken exactly as directed by your doctor. It can be taken with or without food, ideally at the same time each day for consistent effect. Avoid exceeding the prescribed dose, as higher amounts may cause unwanted effects.

Over time, your body may develop tolerance to this medicine, meaning the same dose may become less effective. To help reduce this, it is important to follow a strict dosing schedule without missing doses or making unsupervised changes. Always consult your healthcare provider if you notice reduced effectiveness or have any concerns about your dosage plan.

Common side effects of Nitrocontin 2.6mg Tablet include headaches, which can sometimes be intense, dizziness, lightheadedness, flushing, low blood pressure, spinning sensations, drowsiness, nausea, and feelings of weakness. Drinking plenty of fluids and avoiding alcohol may help ease headaches. Lightheadedness can increase the risk of falls, so caution is advised during activities that require balance. There are rarer side effects, some of which may be serious. It is important to read the medicine leaflet thoroughly and consult your doctor to ensure safe use. Always report any unusual or persistent symptoms to your healthcare provider promptly.

Do not use Nitrocontin 2.6mg Tablet if you are currently taking medicines for pulmonary hypertension (high blood pressure in the lungs), erectile dysfunction, or if you have anemia or glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye). Always inform your doctor about any existing health conditions and all other medications you are using. It is advisable to avoid alcohol while taking this medicine, as it can increase certain side effects. If you experience dizziness, refrain from driving or operating machinery until you feel stable. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your healthcare provider before starting this medicine to ensure safety for you and your baby.

mechanismOfAction:
How NITROCONTIN 2.6MG TABLET Works
How Does Nitrocontin 2.6mg Tablet Work?

Nitrocontin 2.6mg Tablet gradually releases nitroglycerin, which relaxes and widens blood vessels. This process reduces the strain on the heart by improving blood flow and lowering the heart's workload, helping to ease chest discomfort associated with angina.

Mechanism of Action: Nitrocontin 2.6mg

The active component, nitroglycerin, converts to nitric oxide (NO) within the body. Nitric oxide activates enzymes that cause relaxation of smooth muscles in the blood vessels. This vasodilation effect increases blood flow through veins and arteries, enhancing oxygen delivery to the heart muscle.

How Nitroglycerin Supports Heart Health

By expanding blood vessels, Nitrocontin helps reduce pressure within the heart and improves circulation. This promotes better oxygen supply to heart tissues and supports more efficient heart function during daily activities.

Understanding Vasodilation with Nitrocontin

Vasodilation occurs when blood vessel walls relax, allowing vessels to widen. Nitrocontin’ s controlled-release formulation ensures sustained vasodilation, maintaining steady blood circulation and reduced cardiac workload over time.

Key Science Behind Nitrocontin 2.6mg Tablet

Nitroglycerin’ s conversion to nitric oxide triggers a series of cellular reactions, leading to decreased calcium in smooth muscle cells and resulting in vessel relaxation. This scientific process underlies Nitrocontin’ s ability to support cardiovascular function by improving blood flow and easing heart strain.

More Information
01. How can you effectively incorporate Nitrocontin 2.6mg tablets into your daily routine, what dietary considerations should you follow, and why is regular heart monitoring or diagnostic testing important?

Aspect

	

Details




Incorporating into Daily Routine

	

Take Nitrocontin 2.6mg tablet as prescribed by your doctor, usually once or twice daily at a fixed time. Swallow the tablet whole with water; do not chew, crush, or break it. Preferably take on an empty stomach for better absorption. Do not skip doses or stop abruptly without medical advice to avoid worsening symptoms.




Dietary Considerations

	

Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice as they increase drug levels and side effects. Avoid alcohol because it enhances low blood pressure risk causing dizziness and fainting. Limit caffeine-containing foods and beverages to control reduced effectiveness. Avoid high-fat meals near dosing time to reduce delayed absorption. Maintain a balanced, heart-healthy diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and low sodium to support cardiovascular health.




Importance of Heart Monitoring / Diagnostic Testing

	

Regular heart monitoring and diagnostic tests (e.g., ECG, stress test) ensure Nitrocontin is effectively managing angina and blood flow to the heart. These tests help detect changes in heart condition early to adjust management timely. Monitoring reduce complications like heart attacks and helps dose adjustments to avoid adverse effects. Always follow up with your healthcare provider for periodic evaluation.

Introduction About GTN SORBITRATE CR 2.6MG TABLET

GTN SORBITRATE CR 2.6MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

name: ISOTRATE 20 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ISOTRATE 20 TABLET

ISOTRATE 20 TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

ISOTRATE 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking ISOTRATE 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). ISOTRATE 20 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking ISOTRATE 20 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About VASODIL 20MG TABLET

VASODIL 20MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

VASODIL 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking VASODIL 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). VASODIL 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking VASODIL 20MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NITROLONG 2.6MG TABLET

Nitrolong 2.6 mg Tablet is a sustained-release tablet formulated to support steady blood flow and oxygen delivery to the heart. It is commonly recommended for patients experiencing angina pectoris, a condition where the heart temporarily receives less oxygen due to narrowed or constricted blood vessels. By relaxing and widening blood vessels, Nitrolong helps maintain consistent circulation and reduces episodes of chest discomfort when used as part of a doctor-guided heart health plan. Its slow-release formulation ensures gradual absorption, offering long-lasting effects throughout the day. 

This medicine is ideal for adults who require ongoing support for heart circulation. Nitrolong is not recommended for children unless advised by a paediatrician. Elderly patients and those with kidney or liver conditions should use it with caution and under close medical supervision. The tablet should be taken exactly as prescribed, usually once or twice daily, and swallowed whole with water. Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to maintain its sustained-release properties. Consistency in timing and adherence to the prescribed schedule helps maintain steady support for heart function.   

Precautions and safety considerations include monitoring for dizziness or lightheadedness, especially when standing up quickly. Avoid alcohol consumption, which may amplify side effects. Nitrolong should be used with caution in patients with low blood pressure, heart disease, or other vascular conditions. It is also advised to inform your doctor about all medications and supplements you are taking to prevent potential interactions. Patients should store the tablets in a cool, dry place and keep them out of reach of children.  

During pregnancy and breastfeeding, Nitrolong should be used only if recommended by a healthcare provider, with careful monitoring. Common side effects include headache, flushing, dizziness, and mild lightheadedness, which often subside as the body adjusts to the medication. Severe reactions such as fainting, unusually low blood pressure, or breathing difficulties require immediate medical attention. Following the prescribed dosage, lifestyle guidance, and routine check-ups can help patients use Nitrolong 2.6 mg safely and effectively as part of a comprehensive heart-support strategy.

mechanismOfAction:
How NITROLONG 2.6MG TABLET Works
Mechanism of Action of Nitrolong 2.6 mg Tablet

Nitrolong 2.6 mg Tablet contains nitroglycerin, a compound that supports heart function by relaxing and widening blood vessels. When the tablet is absorbed into the body, it gradually releases nitroglycerin into the bloodstream. This leads to the production of nitric oxide, a natural molecule that signals the smooth muscles of blood vessels to relax. 

As the blood vessels widen, it allows improved blood flow and oxygen delivery to the heart muscles, which can help reduce the strain on the heart. The sustained-release formulation ensures a gradual and steady effect, maintaining stable support throughout the day rather than causing rapid changes in blood flow.

This action helps in supporting heart health and managing symptoms associated with conditions like angina pectoris. It is important to follow your doctor’s dosing instructions to maintain consistent effectiveness and avoid sudden drops in blood pressure.

Avoid sudden changes in posture immediately after taking the tablet.
Do not adjust the dose or frequency without consulting your doctor.
Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

name: Monotrate SR 30mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET

MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage chronic angina pectoris and it is not recommended for use in sudden or acute angina. Angina pectoris is defined as a sudden, sharp, severe pain originating from the apex of heart and radiating to the left shoulder. The pain is severe and crushing, and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind breastbone.        

MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from lung disease that result in low levels of oxygen in the body (hypoxemia) or cardiac conditions such as low blood volume, low blood pressure, and thickened cardiac muscles (cardiac myopathy) or shock (vascular collapse). Before taking MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney diseases, glaucoma, thyroid problems, or if you suffer from low body temperature.      

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine. It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  

MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. The common side effects of taking MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET are headache, tiredness, dizziness, nausea, decreased blood pressure (hypotension) and rapid heartbeat (palpitations). Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Manage Angina Pectoris (chest pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET
Manage Angina Pectoris (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET Works

MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with blockage of vessels as seen in angina.
usageDetails:

Take MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MONOTRATE SR 30MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET

NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerin that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease. Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest. 

Along with NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern. NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil. NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice. NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET
It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET Works

NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET

Always use NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. For Sublingual Tablet: Place NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition. Continue to take NITROCONTIN 6.4MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: Ivabid 5mg Tablet 14'S
introduction:
Introduction About IVABID 5MG TABLET

IVABID 5MG TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVABID 5MG TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVABID 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVABID 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVABID 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVABID 5MG TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 70 beats/minute)
Chronic heart failure in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 75 beats/minute)

How IVABID 5MG TABLET Works

IVABID 5MG TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.

Take IVABID 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET

MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET Works

MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with blockage of vessels as seen in angina.

Take MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with circulatory collapse or shock, cardiogenic shock, acute myocardial infarction with low left ventricular filling pressure, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), constrictive pericarditis (an inflammation of the heart sac), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart) and aortic/mitral valve stenosis (narrowing of heart valves). It should be used with caution in patients with a recent history of myocardial infarction (heart attack). Consult your doctor before taking MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET.

Others

MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Marked low blood pressure (systolic blood pressure ≤ 90 mmHg)
Severe anemia (low level of red blood cells)
Closed angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eye)
Conditions associated with raised pressure on the brain (following head trauma and cerebral haemorrhage)
Severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume)

Before taking MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hypothyroidism
Suffer from malnutrition
Have low body temperature (hypothermia)

Use in Pediatrics

MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety and effectiveness. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics
MONOTRATE 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About NITRO G 2.6 TABLET

NITRO G 2.6 TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest.

Along with NITRO G 2.6 TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, manage weight and to improve your sleep pattern.

NITRO G 2.6 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

NITRO G 2.6 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

NITRO G 2.6 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking the medicine. NITRO G 2.6 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. NITRO G 2.6 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NITRO G 2.6 TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition. Continue to take NITRO G 2.6 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET

ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest.

Along with ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, manage weight and to improve your sleep pattern.

ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking the medicine. ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease

Uses Of ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET
It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET Works

ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET

Always use ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition. Continue to take ANGIWELL 2.6MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: CARVIDON MR Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About CARVIDON MR TABLET

CARVIDON MR TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

CARVIDON MR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking CARVIDON MR TABLET.

The common side effects associated with CARVIDON MR TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARVIDON MR TABLET Works

CARVIDON MR TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

Take CARVIDON MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RANOLAZ 500MG TABLET

RANOLAZ 500MG TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

RANOLAZ 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOLAZ 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOLAZ 500MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. RANOLAZ 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

RANOLAZ 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOLAZ 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking RANOLAZ 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE

ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling the pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or heavy weight lying on the chest. 

Along with ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern.

ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in the blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking medicine. ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children. ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness and lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE Works

ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE

Always use ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition. Continue to take ANGISTAT 2.5MG CAPSULE for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About CALCIGARD 5MG CAPSULE

CALCIGARD 5MG CAPSULE contains Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high and is characterised by headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, a feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart and characterised by a squeezing type of pain, pressure, heaviness, and tightness in the chest.

CALCIGARD 5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver and heart disease and should be used with caution with patients having kidney dialysis, improper liver function, or poor cardiac reserve. It should be used with caution in pregnant women, and it is not recommended in a breast-feeding woman; consult your doctor for advice.

CALCIGARD 5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking CALCIGARD 5MG CAPSULE are headache, flushing, a general feeling of being unwell, constipation, and swelling, particularly of the ankles and legs. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CALCIGARD 5MG CAPSULE Works

CALCIGARD 5MG CAPSULE reduces blood pressure by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels for easy blood flow and thereby lowers the blood pressure, which reduces the strain on the heart. It also works by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels supplying the heart, which allows more blood and oxygen to reach the heart and decreases the strain on it. This reduces the severity and frequency of angina attacks.

introduction:
Introduction About IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET

IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET Works

IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.

Tablet:

Take IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Take IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place IVABRATCO 5MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TIMZID MR TABLET

TIMZID MR TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

TIMZID MR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking TIMZID MR TABLET.

The common side effects associated with TIMZID MR TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

TIMZID MR TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

introduction:
Introduction About ISORUS TABLET

ISORUS TABLET is a combination of Hydralazine and Isosorbide dinitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used to manage heart failure along with standard therapy in patients to improve survival, delay hospitalization for heart failure and to improve patient-reported functional status.

Heart failure is defined as a progressive clinical disorder where your heart is unable to pump sufficient blood to meet the body’s metabolic needs, characterized by shortness of breath and extreme tiredness.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure to avoid any untoward side effects. The safety and effectiveness of ISORUS TABLET in children have not been established.

Before taking ISORUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, heart, lung or liver problems, too much sweating, fluid loss, vomiting or diarrhea or if you consume alcohol.

ISORUS TABLET is not studied in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ISORUS TABLET are headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
