How ISORUS TABLET Works

ISORUS TABLET helps in the management of heart failure, where hydralazine relaxes the smooth muscles of arteries and isosorbide dinitrate acts by releasing nitric oxide and subsequently activating guanylyl cyclase and ultimately relaxes smooth muscles of both arteries and veins.

introduction:
Introduction About DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET

DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

During management with DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET Works

DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET

Take DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DILTIVAS SR 90MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About BEAT HF 5 TABLET

BEAT HF 5 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. BEAT HF 5 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

BEAT HF 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking BEAT HF 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

BEAT HF 5 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking BEAT HF 5 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 70 beats/minute)
Chronic heart failure in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 75 beats/minute)

mechanismOfAction:
How BEAT HF 5 TABLET Works

BEAT HF 5 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.
usageDetails:

Tablet:

Take BEAT HF 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take BEAT HF 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place BEAT HF 5 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

It should be used with caution in patients with other heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), sustained atrial fibrillation, long QT syndrome, slow heartbeat (associated with signs such as tiredness, dizziness, shortness of breath), and/or bundle branch block (type of severe heart failure). name: Carvidon 20mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CARVIDON 20MG TABLET

CARVIDON 20MG TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

CARVIDON 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking CARVIDON 20MG TABLET.

The common side effects associated with CARVIDON 20MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.
uses: Used to manage ischemic heart disease, angina pectoris, and squeals of infarction
usesDetails:
Uses Of CARVIDON 20MG TABLET
Used to manage ischemic heart disease, angina pectoris, and squeals of infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How CARVIDON 20MG TABLET Works

CARVIDON 20MG TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

Take CARVIDON 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Nitrofix SR 30mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET

NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage chronic angina pectoris and it is not recommended for use in sudden or acute angina. Angina pectoris is defined as a sudden, sharp, severe pain originating from the apex of heart and radiating to the left shoulder. The pain is severe and crushing, and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind breastbone.        

NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from lung disease that result in low levels of oxygen in the body (hypoxemia) or cardiac conditions such as low blood volume, low blood pressure, and thickened cardiac muscles (cardiac myopathy) or shock (vascular collapse). Before taking NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney diseases, glaucoma, thyroid problems, or if you suffer from low body temperature.      

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine. It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  

NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. The common side effects of taking NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET are headache, tiredness, dizziness, nausea, decreased blood pressure (hypotension) and rapid heartbeat (palpitations). Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Manage Angina Pectoris (chest pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET
Manage Angina Pectoris (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET Works

NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with blockage of vessels as seen in angina.

Take NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with sudden anginal attack, low blood volume, low blood pressure, thickened cardiac muscles (cardiac myopathy), hardened heart valves (stenosis), compression of the heart due to fluid around it (cardiac tamponade) and vascular collapse (shock). Consult your doctor before taking NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET.
NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Consult child’s doctor for advice.

NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Your doctor may adjust the dose of NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET due to increased risk of side effects in elderly individuals. Consult your doctor before taking it

Others

NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Elevated pressure inside the eyes (glaucoma)
Disease related to increased pressure inside the head (brain haemorrhage)
A head injury

Before taking NITROFIX SR 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are diagnosed with an underactive thyroid gland
Are undernourished
Have a sustained low body temperature (hypothermia)
Have eye disorders

name: IVANODE OD 10 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About IVANODE OD 10 TABLET

IVANODE OD 10 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVANODE OD 10 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVANODE OD 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVANODE OD 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVANODE OD 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVANODE OD 10 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 70 beats/minute)
Chronic heart failure in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 75 beats/minute)
usesDetails:

Symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 70 beats/minute)
Chronic heart failure in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 75 beats/minute)
mechanismOfAction:
How IVANODE OD 10 TABLET Works

IVANODE OD 10 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals
usageDetails:
How to use IVANODE OD 10 TABLET

Tablet:

Take IVANODE OD 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take IVANODE OD 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place IVANODE OD 10 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About IVABID 7.5MG TABLET

IVABID 7.5MG TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVABID 7.5MG TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVABID 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVABID 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVABID 7.5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVABID 7.5MG TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TIMZID OD 80 CAPSULE

TIMZID OD 80 CAPSULE contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

TIMZID OD 80 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking TIMZID OD 80 CAPSULE.

The common side effects associated with TIMZID OD 80 CAPSULE are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

TIMZID OD 80 CAPSULE works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

introduction:
Introduction About IVABRAD 5MG TABLET

Ivabrad 5 mg tablet is commonly prescribed for patients who require heart rate regulation in conditions like stable angina or certain types of heart rhythm irregularities. It is ideal for individuals where slowing the heart rate is beneficial, especially in cases where beta-blockers or other heart medications might not be suitable. It works by specifically targeting the sinoatrial node the natural pacemaker of the heart to help slow down the heart rate without significantly affecting blood pressure.    

Ivabrad 5 mg tablet is typically taken once or twice daily depending on your doctor’s guidance, with or without food. It is important to follow the dosage instructions provided by your healthcare provider to ensure proper heart rate management. Always take Ivabradine exactly as prescribed to achieve the desired results.  

Before starting Ivabradine, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing conditions such as liver problems, kidney issues, or irregular heart rhythms. Ivabradine should be used cautiously in patients with low blood pressure or heart failure. It is important not to stop taking the medication without consulting your healthcare provider. Common side effects may include dizziness, fatigue, slow heart rate or visual disturbances though not everyone experiences these.

Ivabradine is generally not recommended during pregnancy unless clearly advised by the doctor. Breastfeeding mothers should avoid using Ivabradine as it is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk. Always consult with your healthcare provider before taking this medication during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.

How IVABRAD 5MG TABLET Works
Ivabrad 5 mg role in heart rate control

Ivabrad 5 mg is often considered in clinical routines where guided heart rate regulation is necessary. It works by selectively influencing the activity of the sinoatrial node, a natural pacemaker within the heart, helping to achieve a more consistent resting heart rate.

This approach is especially relevant in individuals who may not tolerate certain other heart rate-modifying options. By focusing solely on the heart rate without significantly altering blood pressure.

Ivabradine advantages in long-term use

Ivabradine is frequently included in long-term heart rate management plans due to its targeted action and consistent profile. Its selective approach allows for pulse regulation while minimizing the influence on other cardiovascular parameters like blood pressure. This makes it a suitable option for patients requiring sustained heart rate control without systemic effects. Over time, its usage can be aligned with lifestyle adjustments and other supportive measures, allowing for a more tailored and well-monitored approach to cardiac rhythm support.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of IVABRAD 5MG TABLET
Ivabrad 5 mg Tablet common side effects
Brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity)
Slow heart rate
Signs of atrial fibrillation (irregular rapid contraction of the heart) such as chest pain, pounding heartbeat, and tiredness
Uncontrolled blood pressure
Headache, dizziness, blurred vision
How long do side effects of Ivabradine last?

The duration of Ivabradine side effects generally varies between individuals. Most common side effects, like visual disturbances (flashes of light) or bradycardia (slow heart rate), tend to be temporary and usually subside within a few days to weeks as the body adjusts to the medication. Headaches and gastrointestinal discomfort may also improve within a short period.

If side effects persist or worsen, such as significant dizziness or fatigue, dosage adjustments or discontinuation may be necessary. For more serious issues, it's important to consult a healthcare provider promptly. Regular monitoring of heart rate and symptoms can help manage side effects effectively.

When to Seek Medical Attention?

It is important to seek medical attention if you experience any of the following while taking Ivabrad 5 mg:

Severe bradycardia (slow heart rate): If your resting heart rate drops below 50 bpm or if you experience symptoms like dizziness, fatigue, or fainting, contact your healthcare provider immediately.
Visual disturbances: If you experience persistent or bothersome flashes of light or other visual changes that interfere with daily activities, notify your doctor.
Signs of heart failure worsening: Increased shortness of breath, swelling in the legs, or rapid weight gain may indicate worsening heart failure, requiring prompt medical evaluation.
Severe chest pain or discomfort: Though Ivabradine is used to treat angina, if you experience new or worsening chest pain, seek medical help right away.
Allergic reactions: If you develop signs of an allergic reaction such as rash, itching, swelling (especially of the face, tongue, or throat), or difficulty breathing, seek immediate medical attention.
Unusual symptoms: If you feel unusually weak, confused, or experience any side effects that are not typical, contact your healthcare provider for advice.

Early intervention can help prevent complications, so it's crucial to stay in regular contact with your healthcare team while on Ivabradine.

name: CORABRAD 5 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About CORABRAD 5 TABLET

CORABRAD 5 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. CORABRAD 5 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

CORABRAD 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking CORABRAD 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

CORABRAD 5 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CORABRAD 5 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 70 beats/minute)
Chronic heart failure in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 75 beats/minute)

mechanismOfAction:
How CORABRAD 5 TABLET Works

CORABRAD 5 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.
usageDetails:

Tablet:

Take CORABRAD 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take CORABRAD 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place CORABRAD 5 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ROLAZIN TABLET

ROLAZIN TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

ROLAZIN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

ROLAZIN TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

ROLAZIN TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. ROLAZIN TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

ROLAZIN TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

ROLAZIN TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking ROLAZIN TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

ROLAZIN TABLET works by inhibiting the entry of sodium and potassium into the heart cells, thereby managing the calcium influx causing vasodilation and reduces ventricular tension, myocardial oxygen demand. Thus, relieving angina symptoms.

name: IVASAFE 5 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About IVASAFE 5 TABLET

IVASAFE 5 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVASAFE 5 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVASAFE 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVASAFE 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVASAFE 5 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVASAFE 5 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Chronic heart failure in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 75 beats/minute)

How IVASAFE 5 TABLET Works

IVASAFE 5 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.

Tablet:

Take IVASAFE 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take IVASAFE 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place IVASAFE 5 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Isonorm 10mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ISONORM 10MG TABLET

ISONORM 10MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by a feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

ISONORM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISONORM 10MG TABLET

Manages Angina Pectoris (chest pain) and heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How ISONORM 10MG TABLET Works

ISONORM 10MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with the blockage of vessels as seen in angina.
usageDetails:
How to use ISONORM 10MG TABLET

Take ISONORM 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ISONORM 10MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and those who are planning for pregnancy unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET.
ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision, dizziness or light-headedness after standing up or moving suddenly after taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET because it might increase the risk of dizziness and fainting due to a reduction in blood pressure.
ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the kidney. Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET.
ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the liver. Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET.
Do not take ISONORM 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to isosorbide mononitrate or other nitrates (such as isosorbide dinitrate)

ISONORM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with circulatory collapse or shock, cardiogenic shock, acute myocardial infarction with low left ventricular filling pressure, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), constrictive pericarditis (an inflammation of the heart sac), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart) and aortic/mitral valve stenosis (narrowing of heart valves). It should be used with caution in patients with a recent history of myocardial infarction (heart attack). Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET.
ISONORM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety and effectiveness. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ISONORM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Marked low blood pressure (systolic blood pressure ≤ 90 mmHg)
Severe anemia (low level of red blood cells)
Closed angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eye)
Conditions associated with raised pressure on the brain (following head trauma and cerebral haemorrhage)
Severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume)

Before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hypothyroidism
Suffer from malnutrition
Have low body temperature (hypothermia)

ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and those who are planning for pregnancy unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET. 

Breastfeeding
MONITORING REQUIRED

ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET. 

Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION

Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision, dizziness or light-headedness after standing up or moving suddenly after taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET.

Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET because it might increase the risk of dizziness and fainting due to a reduction in blood pressure.

Kidney
USE WITH CAUTION

ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the kidney. Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET.

Liver
USE WITH CAUTION

ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the liver. Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take ISONORM 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to isosorbide mononitrate or other nitrates (such as isosorbide dinitrate)

Heart Disease
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

ISONORM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with circulatory collapse or shock, cardiogenic shock, acute myocardial infarction with low left ventricular filling pressure, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), constrictive pericarditis (an inflammation of the heart sac), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart) and aortic/mitral valve stenosis (narrowing of heart valves). It should be used with caution in patients with a recent history of myocardial infarction (heart attack). Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET.

Use In Pediatrics
CONTRAINDICATED

ISONORM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety and effectiveness. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION

ISONORM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Before taking ISONORM 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage male impotency (Ex. sildenafil, tadalafil, alprostadil)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as calcium channel blockers (Ex. verapamil), angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors (Ex. captopril, lisinopril), angiotensin II receptor blockers (Ex. azilsartan, candesartan), beta-blockers (Ex, metoprolol, atenolol) and diuretics (Ex. hydrochlorothiazide)

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ISONORM 10MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Introduction About CARVIDON OD TABLET

CARVIDON OD TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

CARVIDON OD TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking CARVIDON OD TABLET.

The common side effects associated with CARVIDON OD TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

How CARVIDON OD TABLET Works

CARVIDON OD TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

introduction:
Introduction About AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET

AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

How AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET Works

AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.

introduction:
Introduction About ANGIZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE

ANGIZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with ANGIZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ANGIZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ANGIZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

ANGIZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking ANGIZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

ANGIZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.

ANGIZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with a previous history of asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

It should be used with caution in patients with a previous history of heart failure, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or low blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About 5 MONO 20MG TABLET

5 MONO 20MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

5 MONO 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking 5 MONO 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). 5 MONO 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking 5 MONO 20MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How 5 MONO 20MG TABLET Works

5 MONO 20MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with blockage of vessels as seen in angina.

Take 5 MONO 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of 5 MONO 20MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

5 MONO 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety and effectiveness. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

5 MONO 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIVEDON MR TABLET

TRIVEDON MR TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

TRIVEDON MR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking TRIVEDON MR TABLET.

The common side effects associated with TRIVEDON MR TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

TRIVEDON MR TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

introduction:
Introduction About APRESOL PLUS TABLET

APRESOL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Hydralazine and Isosorbide dinitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used to manage heart failure along with standard therapy in patients to improve survival, delay hospitalization for heart failure and to improve patient-reported functional status.

Heart failure is defined as a progressive clinical disorder where your heart is unable to pump sufficient blood to meet the body’s metabolic needs, characterized by shortness of breath and extreme tiredness.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure to avoid any untoward side effects. The safety and effectiveness of APRESOL PLUS TABLET in children have not been established.

Before taking APRESOL PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, heart, lung or liver problems, too much sweating, fluid loss, vomiting or diarrhea or if you consume alcohol.

APRESOL PLUS TABLET is not studied in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking APRESOL PLUS TABLET are headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Manage heart failure

How APRESOL PLUS TABLET Works

APRESOL PLUS TABLET helps in the management of heart failure, where hydralazine relaxes the smooth muscles of arteries and isosorbide dinitrate acts by releasing nitric oxide and subsequently activating guanylyl cyclase and ultimately relaxes smooth muscles of both arteries and veins.

Take APRESOL PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About IVABID OD 10 TABLET

IVABID OD 10 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVABID OD 10 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVABID OD 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVABID OD 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVABID OD 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVABID OD 10 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How IVABID OD 10 TABLET Works

IVABID OD 10 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals
usageDetails:
How to use IVABID OD 10 TABLET

Tablet:

Take IVABID OD 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take IVABID OD 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place IVABID OD 10 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

IVABID OD 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Do not drive or operate any machines after taking IVABID OD 10 TABLET since it may cause temporary blindness (due to sudden changes in light intensity) which may after your ability to concentrate while driving or operating machines.
IVABID OD 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

IVABID OD 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not take IVABID OD 10 TABLET if you are allergic to ivabradine, and/or any other ingredients of this medicine.

IVABID OD 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as slow resting heart rate (beats below 70/minute), cardiogenic shock, heart rhythm disorders (such as sick sinus syndrome, sino-atrial block, heart block), heavy heart attack, and/or severe heart failure. It should be used with caution in patients with other heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), sustained atrial fibrillation, long QT syndrome, slow heartbeat (associated with signs such as tiredness, dizziness, shortness of breath), and/or bundle branch block (type of severe heart failure). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Others

IVABID OD 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Suffer from very low blood pressure
Have unstable angina (a severe form of chest pain)

Before taking IVABID OD 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Had a recent stroke (cerebral attack)
Suffer from mild to moderate low blood pressure (after change in antihypertensive management)
Have chronic eye retinal disease

IVABID OD 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

IVABID OD 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET

CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

During management with CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage and manages angina (chest pain)

Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET Works

CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.

Take CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking CHANNEL SR 90 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CORALAN 5MG TABLET

CORALAN 5MG TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. CORALAN 5MG TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

CORALAN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking CORALAN 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

CORALAN 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CORALAN 5MG TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CORALAN 5MG TABLET Works

CORALAN 5MG TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.

Do not drive or operate any machines after taking CORALAN 5MG TABLET since it may cause temporary blindness (due to sudden changes in light intensity) which may after your ability to concentrate while driving or operating machines.

It should be used with caution in patients with other heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), sustained atrial fibrillation, long QT syndrome, slow heartbeat (associated with signs such as tiredness, dizziness, shortness of breath), and/or bundle branch block (type of severe heart failure). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About RANX 1GM TABLET

RANX 1GM TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

RANX 1GM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANX 1GM TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANX 1GM TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. RANX 1GM TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

RANX 1GM TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANX 1GM TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking RANX 1GM TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CORALAN OD 10MG TABLET

CORALAN OD 10MG TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. CORALAN OD 10MG TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

CORALAN OD 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking CORALAN OD 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

CORALAN OD 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CORALAN OD 10MG TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

CORALAN OD 10MG TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals

introduction:
Introduction About NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET

NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerin that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease. Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest. 

Along with NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern. NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil. NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice. NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

How NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET Works

NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition. Continue to take NITROLONG 6.4MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About MONIT 20MG TABLET

MONIT 20MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

MONIT 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking MONIT 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). MONIT 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking MONIT 20MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MONIT 20MG TABLET Works

MONIT 20MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with blockage of vessels as seen in angina.

Take MONIT 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MONIT 20MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume)

Have low body temperature (hypothermia)

MONIT 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety and effectiveness. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics
MONIT 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About NITROX XL 6.4 TABLET

NITROX XL 6.4 TABLET contains Nitroglycerin that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease. Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest. 

Along with NITROX XL 6.4 TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern. NITROX XL 6.4 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil. NITROX XL 6.4 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

NITROX XL 6.4 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice. NITROX XL 6.4 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. NITROX XL 6.4 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking NITROX XL 6.4 TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

introduction:
Introduction About CORALAN 7.5MG TABLET

CORALAN 7.5MG TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. CORALAN 7.5MG TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

CORALAN 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking CORALAN 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

CORALAN 7.5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CORALAN 7.5MG TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

name: Vasovin XL 2.5mg Capsule 25'S
introduction:
Introduction About VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE

VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling the pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or heavy weight lying on the chest. 

Along with VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern.

VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in the blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking medicine. VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children. VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness and lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE Works

VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.

Always use VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition. Continue to take VASOVIN XL 2.5MG CAPSULE for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
