introduction:
Introduction About NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET

NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest.

Along with NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, manage weight and to improve your sleep pattern.

NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking the medicine. NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET
It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET Works

NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET

Always use NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition. Continue to take NITROX XL 2.6 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: Korandil 10mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About KORANDIL 10MG TABLET

KORANDIL 10MG TABLET contains Nicorandil which belongs to the group of medicines called Potassium channel activators. It is used in adults to manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris who cannot take heart medicines called beta-blockers or calcium antagonists.    

Angina pectoris is a type of temporary chest pain or discomfort which occurs as a result of decreased blood flow to the heart muscle which is usually not a heart attack but a sign of increased risk for heart attack that is generally characterized by symptoms such as squeezing pressure, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest that can occur sudden or recur over time.    

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with KORANDIL 10MG TABLET as it may reduce your blood pressure even more.       

KORANDIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe low blood pressure, low blood volume, heart problems (such as cardiogenic shock, left ventricular failure with low filling pressure or cardiac decompensation).       

Before taking KORANDIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have lung problems such as pulmonary oedema (condition marked by fluid build-up in lungs), hepatic impairment or kidney problems.       

KORANDIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking it.     

The most common side effects of taking KORANDIL 10MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, skin flushing, nausea, vomiting, weakness and rapid or forceful heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About IVAZINE 5MG TABLET

IVAZINE 5MG TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVAZINE 5MG TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVAZINE 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVAZINE 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVAZINE 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVAZINE 5MG TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How IVAZINE 5MG TABLET Works

IVAZINE 5MG TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use IVAZINE 5MG TABLET

Tablet:

Take IVAZINE 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take IVAZINE 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place IVAZINE 5MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Suffer from very low blood pressure
Have unstable angina (a severe form of chest pain)

Have chronic eye retinal disease

IVAZINE 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

name: Angispan TR 6.5mg Capsule 25'S
introduction:
Introduction About ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE

ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling the pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or heavy weight lying on the chest. 

Along with ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern.

ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in the blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking medicine. ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children. ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness and lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE
It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE Works

ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE

Always use ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition. Continue to take ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Have raised pressure in the head (including that caused by accident)
Bleeding on the brain (pain in eyes, changes in vision, bad headache behind the eyes)
Raised pressure in the eye

Underactive thyroid gland
Low body temperature
Malnutrition (poor nutrition due to digestion problems or imbalanced diet)
Abnormally decreased levels of oxygen in the blood
Severely low blood pressure
Low blood volume
Conditions that lower the blood volume in the heart
Cerebrovascular diseases (diseases affecting the blood vessels supplying the brain)

ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children. Ask for the advice of your child’s doctor before giving it to your child.

ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking the medicine.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines for erectile dysfunction (male impotence) (Ex. sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil)

Medicines for migraine (Ex. ergotamine)

Medicines used for thinning your blood and managing blood clots (Ex. warfarin)
Medicines used to manage Parkinson’s disease (Ex. apomorphine)
Medicines used to manage stomach ulcers (Ex. propantheline)
Medicines used to manage anxiety and depression (Ex. amitriptyline, isocarboxazid)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else uses too much of ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage of ANGISPAN TR 6.5MG CAPSULE may include nausea, low blood pressure, restlessness, fainting, blue colouration of the skin, methaemoglobin in the blood, breathing difficulties, lack of oxygen in tissues, slow heartbeat or mental illness.

introduction:
Introduction About CYTOGARD OD 80 CAPSULE

CYTOGARD OD 80 CAPSULE contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

CYTOGARD OD 80 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking CYTOGARD OD 80 CAPSULE.

The common side effects associated with CYTOGARD OD 80 CAPSULE are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

CYTOGARD OD 80 CAPSULE works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

introduction:
Introduction About ISONORM 20MG TABLET

ISONORM 20MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

ISONORM 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking ISONORM 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). ISONORM 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking ISONORM 20MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How ISONORM 20MG TABLET Works

ISONORM 20MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with blockage of vessels as seen in angina.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision, dizziness or light-headedness after standing up or moving suddenly after taking ISONORM 20MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ISONORM 20MG TABLET because it might increase the risk of dizziness and fainting due to reduction in blood pressure.
ISONORM 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the kidney. Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 20MG TABLET.
ISONORM 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the liver. Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 20MG TABLET.
Do not take ISONORM 20MG TABLET if you are allergic to isosorbide mononitrate or other nitrates (such as isosorbide dinitrate)

ISONORM 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with circulatory collapse or shock, cardiogenic shock, acute myocardial infarction with low left ventricular filling pressure, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), constrictive pericarditis (an inflammation of the heart sac), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart) and aortic/mitral valve stenosis (narrowing of heart valves). It should be used with caution in patients with a recent history of myocardial infarction (heart attack). Consult your doctor before taking ISONORM 20MG TABLET.

Others

Marked low blood pressure (systolic blood pressure ≤ 90 mmHg)
Severe anemia (low level of red blood cells)
Closed angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eye)
Conditions associated with raised pressure on the brain (following head trauma and cerebral haemorrhage)
Severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume)

Before taking ISONORM 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hypothyroidism
Suffer from malnutrition

introduction:
Introduction About MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET

MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerin that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease. Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest. 

Along with MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern. MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil. MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice. MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

How MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET Works

MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET

Always use MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. For Sublingual Tablet: Place MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition. Continue to take MYONIT SR 6.4MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Introduction About RANGIL XL 500MG TABLET

RANGIL XL 500MG TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

RANGIL XL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANGIL XL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANGIL XL 500MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. RANGIL XL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

RANGIL XL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANGIL XL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking RANGIL XL 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIMACONTIN 60MG TABLET

TRIMACONTIN 60MG TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

TRIMACONTIN 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking TRIMACONTIN 60MG TABLET.

The common side effects associated with TRIMACONTIN 60MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.
uses: Used to manage ischemic heart disease, angina pectoris, and squeals of infarction

Used to manage ischemic heart disease, angina pectoris, and squeals of infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIMACONTIN 60MG TABLET Works

TRIMACONTIN 60MG TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

Take TRIMACONTIN 60MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Introduction About RANX 500MG TABLET

RANX 500MG TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

RANX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANX 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANX 500MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. RANX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

RANX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANX 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking RANX 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NITROTRET CR 6.4MG TABLET

NITROTRET CR 6.4MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerin that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease. Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest. 

Along with NITROTRET CR 6.4MG TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern. NITROTRET CR 6.4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil. NITROTRET CR 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

NITROTRET CR 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice. NITROTRET CR 6.4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. NITROTRET CR 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking NITROTRET CR 6.4MG TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

Continue to take NITROTRET CR 6.4MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About RANOPILL 500MG TABLET

RANOPILL 500MG TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

RANOPILL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOPILL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOPILL 500MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. RANOPILL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

RANOPILL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOPILL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking RANOPILL 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

Used to manage chronic angina
mechanismOfAction:
How RANOPILL 500MG TABLET Works

RANOPILL 500MG TABLET works by inhibiting the entry of sodium and potassium into the heart cells, thereby managing the calcium influx causing vasodilation and reduces ventricular tension, myocardial oxygen demand. Thus, relieving angina symptoms.

Take RANOPILL 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET

MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest.

Along with MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, manage weight and to improve your sleep pattern.

MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking the medicine. MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease

Uses Of MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET
It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET Works

MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET

Always use MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition. Continue to take MYONIT SR 2.6MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: CYTOGARD MR Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CYTOGARD MR TABLET

CYTOGARD MR TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

CYTOGARD MR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking CYTOGARD MR TABLET.

The common side effects associated with CYTOGARD MR TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.
uses: Used to manage ischemic heart disease, angina pectoris, and squeals of infarction
usesDetails:
Uses Of CYTOGARD MR TABLET
Used to manage ischemic heart disease, angina pectoris, and squeals of infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How CYTOGARD MR TABLET Works

CYTOGARD MR TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.
usageDetails:
How to use CYTOGARD MR TABLET

Take CYTOGARD MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RANCV 500 TABLET

RANCV 500 TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

RANCV 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANCV 500 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANCV 500 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. RANCV 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

RANCV 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANCV 500 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking RANCV 500 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

How RANCV 500 TABLET Works

RANCV 500 TABLET works by inhibiting the entry of sodium and potassium into the heart cells, thereby managing the calcium influx causing vasodilation and reduces ventricular tension, myocardial oxygen demand. Thus, relieving angina symptoms.

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, telithromycin, erythromycin)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. itraconazole, ketoconazole, fluconazole, voriconazole, posaconazole)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (atazanavir, nelfinavir, ritonavir, indinavir, saquinavir tenofovir disoproxil and efavirenz)

Medicines used to manage heart problems or heart rhythm disorders (Ex. quinidine, dofetilide, sotalol, metoprolol, diltiazem, verapamil, procainamide, disopyramide)
Medicine used to manage rejection of a transplanted organ (cyclosporine, tacrolimus, sirolimus, everolimus)

Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, rifampin, rifabutin, rifapentine)

Digoxin (medicines used for heart failure)
Medicines used to manage allergies (Ex. terfenadine, astemizole, mizolastine)
Medicines to manage psychoses (Ex. bupropion, imipramine, doxepin, amitriptyline, paroxetine)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. cyclophosphamide)
Medicines to manage elevated cholesterol levels in the blood (Ex. simvastatin, lovastatin, atorvastatin)

Metformin (medicines used to manage diabetes mellitus)

introduction:
Introduction About IVABID OD 15 TABLET

IVABID OD 15 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVABID OD 15 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVABID OD 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVABID OD 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVABID OD 15 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVABID OD 15 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Chronic heart failure in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 75 beats/minute)

mechanismOfAction:
How IVABID OD 15 TABLET Works

IVABID OD 15 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.
usageDetails:

Tablet:

Take IVABID OD 15 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Take IVABID OD 15 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place IVABID OD 15 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: ISONITRATE 10 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ISONITRATE 10 TABLET

ISONITRATE 10 TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by a feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

ISONITRATE 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking ISONITRATE 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). ISONITRATE 10 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking ISONITRATE 10 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of ISONITRATE 10 TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How ISONITRATE 10 TABLET Works

ISONITRATE 10 TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with the blockage of vessels as seen in angina.

ISONITRATE 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the kidney. Consult your doctor before taking ISONITRATE 10 TABLET.
ISONITRATE 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the liver. Consult your doctor before taking ISONITRATE 10 TABLET.

ISONITRATE 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with circulatory collapse or shock, cardiogenic shock, acute myocardial infarction with low left ventricular filling pressure, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), constrictive pericarditis (an inflammation of the heart sac), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart) and aortic/mitral valve stenosis (narrowing of heart valves). It should be used with caution in patients with a recent history of myocardial infarction (heart attack). Consult your doctor before taking ISONITRATE 10 TABLET.

ISONITRATE 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ISONITRATE 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Marked low blood pressure (systolic blood pressure ≤ 90 mmHg)
Severe anemia (low level of red blood cells)
Closed angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eye)
Conditions associated with raised pressure on the brain (following head trauma and cerebral haemorrhage)
Severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume)

Before taking ISONITRATE 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hypothyroidism
Suffer from malnutrition
Have low body temperature (hypothermia)

introduction:
Introduction About TRIMACONTIN 35MG TABLET

TRIMACONTIN 35MG TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

TRIMACONTIN 35MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking TRIMACONTIN 35MG TABLET.

The common side effects associated with TRIMACONTIN 35MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

How TRIMACONTIN 35MG TABLET Works

TRIMACONTIN 35MG TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

introduction:
Introduction About DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET

DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage and manages angina (chest pain)

mechanismOfAction:
How DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET Works

DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.

Take DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DILCONTIN 60MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET

ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerin that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease. Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest. 

Along with ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern. ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil. ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice. ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease

It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease

How ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET Works

ANGIWELL 6.4MG TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About CYTOGARD 20MG TABLET

CYTOGARD 20MG TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

CYTOGARD 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking CYTOGARD 20MG TABLET.

The common side effects associated with CYTOGARD 20MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

CYTOGARD 20MG TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

introduction:
Introduction About RANCAD 1000MG TABLET

RANCAD 1000MG TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

RANCAD 1000MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

introduction:
Introduction About MONO ISORDIL 20MG TABLET

MONO ISORDIL 20MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

MONO ISORDIL 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking MONO ISORDIL 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). MONO ISORDIL 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking MONO ISORDIL 20MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How MONO ISORDIL 20MG TABLET Works

MONO ISORDIL 20MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with blockage of vessels as seen in angina.

introduction:
Introduction About METAGARD CR 35MG TABLET

METAGARD CR 35MG TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

METAGARD CR 35MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking METAGARD CR 35MG TABLET.

The common side effects associated with METAGARD CR 35MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

name: ISONITRATE 60 SR Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET

ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris, which is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind breastbone.   

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.              

ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as constrictive pericarditis, cardiac tamponade, heart attack, aortic stenosis, mitral stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, very low blood pressure and close angle glaucoma.   

Before taking ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET is not recommended for use during the first three months of pregnancy and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The common side effects of taking ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET are headache, dizziness and nausea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage angina pectoris (chest pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET
Manage angina pectoris (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET Works

ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with blockage of vessels as seen in angina.
usageDetails:
How to use ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET

Take ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ISONITRATE 60 SR TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Very low blood pressure

Closed angle glaucoma

Medicines used to manage male impotency (Ex. sildenafil, tadalafil, alprostadil)

name: FLAVEDAC 35mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About FLAVEDAC 35MG TABLET

FLAVEDAC 35MG TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

FLAVEDAC 35MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking FLAVEDAC 35MG TABLET.

The common side effects associated with FLAVEDAC 35MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.
uses: Used to manage ischemic heart disease, angina pectoris, and squeals of infarction
usesDetails:

Used to manage ischemic heart disease, angina pectoris, and squeals of infarction
mechanismOfAction:
How FLAVEDAC 35MG TABLET Works

FLAVEDAC 35MG TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

Take FLAVEDAC 35MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: NITROVAG 6.4 Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET

NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest. 

Along with NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern.

NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking the medicine. NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET
It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET Works

NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET

Always use NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition. Continue to take NITROVAG 6.4 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About IVADIB 5 TABLET

IVADIB 5 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVADIB 5 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVADIB 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVADIB 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVADIB 5 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVADIB 5 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 70 beats/minute)
Chronic heart failure in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 75 beats/minute)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How IVADIB 5 TABLET Works

IVADIB 5 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.
usageDetails:

Tablet:

Take IVADIB 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take IVADIB 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place IVADIB 5 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MONIT 10MG TABLET

MONIT 10MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by a feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

MONIT 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking MONIT 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). MONIT 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking MONIT 10MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MONIT 10MG TABLET

Manages Angina Pectoris (chest pain) and heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How MONIT 10MG TABLET Works

MONIT 10MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with the blockage of vessels as seen in angina.

Take MONIT 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MONIT 10MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET

NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest.

Along with NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, manage weight and to improve your sleep pattern.

NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking the medicine. NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease

It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease

NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.

If you or anyone else uses too much of NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage of NITRUS CR 2.6MG TABLET may include nausea, low blood pressure, restlessness, fainting, blue coloration of the skin, methaemoglobin in the blood, breathing difficulties, lack of oxygen in tissues, slow heartbeat or mental illness.

introduction:
Introduction About CALCHEK 5MG TABLET

CALCHEK 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take CALCHEK 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking CALCHEK 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of CALCHEK 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking CALCHEK 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)

mechanismOfAction:
How CALCHEK 5MG TABLET Works

CALCHEK 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

CALCHEK 5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking CALCHEK 5MG TABLET.
CALCHEK 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take CALCHEK 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

CALCHEK 5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
CALCHEK 5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
CALCHEK 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.
