name: Amdepin AT Tablet 14'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMDEPIN AT TABLET

AMDEPIN AT TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMDEPIN AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMDEPIN AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMDEPIN AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMDEPIN AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMDEPIN AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMDEPIN AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Uses Of AMDEPIN AT TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How AMDEPIN AT TABLET Works

AMDEPIN AT TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

AMDEPIN AT TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk to the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking AMDEPIN AT TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking AMDEPIN AT TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
AMDEPIN AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMDEPIN AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take AMDEPIN AT TABLET if you are allergic to Atenolol, Amlodipine or to any other beta blockers (such as propranolol) or calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem).
AMDEPIN AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have or previously had any breathing problems such as asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

AMDEPIN AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMDEPIN AT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
AMDEPIN AT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

AMDEPIN AT TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking AMDEPIN AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

introduction:
Introduction About CARTINEX 500MG TABLET

CARTINEX 500MG TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

CARTINEX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

CARTINEX 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

CARTINEX 500MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. CARTINEX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

CARTINEX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

CARTINEX 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking CARTINEX 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARTINEX 500MG TABLET Works

CARTINEX 500MG TABLET works by inhibiting the entry of sodium and potassium into the heart cells, thereby managing the calcium influx causing vasodilation and reduces ventricular tension, myocardial oxygen demand. Thus, relieving angina symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About IVAPRIDE 5 TABLET

IVAPRIDE 5 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVAPRIDE 5 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVAPRIDE 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVAPRIDE 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVAPRIDE 5 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVAPRIDE 5 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 70 beats/minute)
Chronic heart failure in adult patients (with heart rate above/equal to 75 beats/minute)

How IVAPRIDE 5 TABLET Works

IVAPRIDE 5 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.

name: Calchek 2.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CALCHEK 2.5MG TABLET

CALCHEK 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take CALCHEK 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking CALCHEK 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of CALCHEK 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking CALCHEK 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
uses: High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALCHEK 2.5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How CALCHEK 2.5MG TABLET Works

CALCHEK 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

introduction:
Introduction About FLAVETAG 20 MG TABLET

FLAVETAG 20 MG TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

FLAVETAG 20 MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking FLAVETAG 20 MG TABLET.

The common side effects associated with FLAVETAG 20 MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

How FLAVETAG 20 MG TABLET Works

FLAVETAG 20 MG TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

Take FLAVETAG 20 MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Introduction About RANOLAZ OD TABLET

RANOLAZ OD TABLET contains Ranolazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginals. It is used to manage chronic angina.

Angina pectoris can be defined as a sudden, sharp and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

RANOLAZ OD TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease, moderate to severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOLAZ OD TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease, mild liver disease and moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOLAZ OD TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking. RANOLAZ OD TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

RANOLAZ OD TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

RANOLAZ OD TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice as it may lead to unwanted effects. The most common side effects of taking RANOLAZ OD TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness headache and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How RANOLAZ OD TABLET Works

RANOLAZ OD TABLET works by inhibiting the entry of sodium and potassium into the heart cells, thereby managing the calcium influx causing vasodilation and reduces ventricular tension, myocardial oxygen demand. Thus, relieving angina symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE

ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage and manages angina (chest pain)
usesDetails:

Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE Works

ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE

Take ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking ANGIZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET

IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET Works

IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals.

Tablet:

Take IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Take IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place IVABRAD OD 15 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FLAVEDON MR 35MG TABLET
What is Flavedon MR 35mg?

Flavedon MR 35mg is a medication used to manage stable angina and improve heart function. It contains Trimetazidine which helps to maintain energy metabolism in heart cells.

Flavedon Tablet helps to reduce chest pain (angina), improves heart function in ischemic conditions and helps in maintaining energy metabolism.

Take Flavedon MR 35mg as prescribed by your doctor. It is usually taken twice daily with meals.

Flavedon MR 35mg is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking Flavedon MR 35mg.

The common side effects associated with Flavedon MR 35mg are dizziness, nausea, stomach pain. Consult your doctor if the any of the above side effects persists for a longer duration.
uses: Used to manage Angina and improve heart health
usesDetails:

Used to manage Angina and improve heart health
mechanismOfAction:
How FLAVEDON MR 35MG TABLET Works

1. Shifts energy production from fatty acid oxidation to glucose oxidation:

Trimetazidine selectively inhibits an enzyme called 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase (3-KAT) in fatty acid metabolism
This reduces fatty acid oxidation and enhances glucose oxidation, which is more oxygen-efficient and beneficial for ischemic tissues

2. Maintains ATP (Energy) levels in heart cells:

By optimizing glucose oxidation, Flavedon MR helps heart cells produce more ATP, ensuring better cell function under ischemic stress

3. Reduces calcium overload & cell decay

Ischemia can cause calcium accumulation in heart cells, leading to mitochondrial damage and cell decay
Flavedon MR stabilizes calcium balance, reducing oxidative stress and cell injury

Animal studies do not show direct teratogenic effects, but due to insufficient human data, its safety remains unclear. Doctors generally avoid prescribing Flavedon MR 35mg to pregnant women unless the potential benefit outweighs the risk.

There are no human studies confirming whether Trimetazidine passes into breast milk. Given the lack of safety data, it is better to avoid Flavedon MR 35mg while breastfeeding to reduce the potential risks to the baby. If the management is essential, consider switching to formula feeding under medical supervision.

Flavedon MR is not approved for use in children and adolescents under 18 due to a lack of clinical safety data.

Why?

The effects of trimetazidine on a developing heart and metabolism are not well studied
Children with heart conditions should follow alternative managements prescribed by a pediatric cardiologist
Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION

Flavedon MR 35mg should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 75 years).
moreInfo:
More Information
Angina Pectoris:

What is Angina Pectoris?

Angina pectoris is chest pain or discomfort caused by reduced blood flow to the heart muscle. It is a symptom of coronary artery disease (CAD), where the arteries supplying blood to the heart become narrowed or blocked due to plaque buildup (atherosclerosis).

Causes of Angina: Angina occurs when the heart does not receive enough oxygen-rich blood to meet its demands. The most common causes include:

Coronary artery disease (CAD)
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Anemia
Heart valve disease
Stress & anxiety
Cold weather or large meals

Symptoms of Angina

Chest pain or discomfort (may spread to the arms, neck, jaw, shoulders, or back)
Shortness of breath
Fatigue or dizziness
Nausea or sweating
Pain triggered by physical exertion or stress and relieved by rest

Management of Angina

Lifestyle changes – quit smoking, exercise regularly, manage stress, practice meditation, or deep breathing and maintain a healthy weight
Medications for Angina: Nitrates beta-blockers, Calcium channel blockers, Antiplatelet drugs, Flavedon MR (trimetazidine)
Medical procedures (for severe cases): Angioplasty & sent placement, Coronary artery bypass surgery (CABG)
2. Ischemic Heart Disease:

What is Ischemic Heart Disease (IHD)?

Ischemic Heart Disease (IHD), also known as Coronary Artery Disease (CAD), occurs when the heart’s blood supply is reduced due to the narrowing or blockage of coronary arteries. This is primarily caused by atherosclerosis, a condition where fatty deposits (plaque) build up inside the arteries.

Why is IHD serious?

Reduced blood flow leads to angina (chest pain)
Severe blockage can result in a heart attack (myocardial infarction)
Long-term IHD can lead to heart failure or arrhythmias (irregular heartbeats)

Modifiable risk factors (Things you can control)

High Blood Pressure  
High Cholesterol
Smoking
Diabetes
Obesity
Physical inactivity
Unhealthy diet
Stress
Excessive alcohol consumption

Non-Modifiable Risk Factors (Things you cannot control)

Age: Risk increases after 45 years (men) and 55 years (women)
Gender: Men are at higher risk, though postmenopausal women also face increased risk
Family History
Genetic Factors

introduction:
Introduction About FLAVETAG 35MG TABLET

FLAVETAG 35MG TABLET contains Trimetazidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-anginal agents. It is used in adult patients for the management of angina pectoris (chest pain caused by a heart disease) along with other medicines. It protects the heart cells from the effects of a reduced oxygen supply during an episode of angina.

Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart. It is a symptom of an underlying coronary heart disease (narrowing or blockage of blood vessels that carry blood and oxygen to the heart). It is characterized by sudden, sharp, and severe pain, pressure, or discomfort in the chest radiating to the left shoulder. The discomfort can also be felt in the jaw, neck, back, or abdomen. Some people may also suffer from shortness of breath or fatigue.

FLAVETAG 35MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have Parkinson disease (a brain disorder that affects movement (trembling, rigid posture, slow movements, and a shuffling, unbalanced walk)) or severe kidney problems.

This medicine should be used cautiously in elderly patients (above 75 years), pregnant, and breast-feeding mothers. Do not drive or operate any machinery if you feel dizzy after taking FLAVETAG 35MG TABLET.

The common side effects associated with FLAVETAG 35MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion, the feeling of being sick, rashes, itching, hives, and a feeling of weakness. Consult your doctor if the condition persists for long or worsens.

How FLAVETAG 35MG TABLET Works

FLAVETAG 35MG TABLET works by optimizing metabolism of fatty acids and glucose, thereby allowing more blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart. It also reduces thickening and scarring of heart tissue. This results in reducing chest pain due to blood vessel narrowing or blocking.

Take FLAVETAG 35MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Myonit Insta Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About MYONIT INSTA TABLET

MYONIT INSTA TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling the pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or heavy weight lying on the chest. 

Along with MYONIT INSTA TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern.

MYONIT INSTA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

MYONIT INSTA TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in the blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

MYONIT INSTA TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking medicine. MYONIT INSTA TABLET is not recommended for use in children. MYONIT INSTA TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking MYONIT INSTA TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness and lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease

MYONIT INSTA TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.

Always use MYONIT INSTA TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place MYONIT INSTA TABLET inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition. Continue to take MYONIT INSTA TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE

ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling the pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or heavy weight lying on the chest. 

Along with ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, managing weight and improving your sleep pattern.

ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in the head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in the blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking medicine. ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children. ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness and lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

Uses Of ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE
It is used for the management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE Works

ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE

Always use ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition. Continue to take ANGIPLAT 2.5MG CAPSULE for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About KCOR 5MG TABLET

KCOR 5MG TABLET contains Nicorandil which belongs to the group of medicines called Potassium channel activators. It is used in adults to manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris who cannot take heart medicines called beta-blockers or calcium antagonists.    

Angina pectoris is a type of temporary chest pain or discomfort which occurs as a result of decreased blood flow to the heart muscle which is usually not a heart attack but a sign of increased risk for heart attack that is generally characterized by symptoms such as squeezing pressure, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest that can occur sudden or recur over time.    

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with KCOR 5MG TABLET as it may reduce your blood pressure even more.       

KCOR 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe low blood pressure, low blood volume, heart problems (such as cardiogenic shock, left ventricular failure with low filling pressure or cardiac decompensation).       

Before taking KCOR 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have lung problems such as pulmonary oedema (condition marked by fluid build-up in lungs), hepatic impairment or kidney problems.       

KCOR 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking it.     

The most common side effects of taking KCOR 5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, skin flushing, nausea, vomiting, weakness and rapid or forceful heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

KCOR 5MG TABLET works by increasing blood flow through the heart vessels, leading to improved blood and oxygen supply to the heart muscle thus reducing the workload of the heart which results in reducing the frequency and severity of angina attacks.

Angina pectoris is a type of temporary chest pain or discomfort which occurs as a result of decreased blood flow to the heart muscle which is usually not a heart attack but a sign of increased risk for heart attack that is generally characterized by symptoms such as squeezing pressure, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest that can occur sudden or recur over time.    

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with NIKORAN 5MG TABLET as it may reduce your blood pressure even more.

Before taking NIKORAN 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have lung problems such as pulmonary oedema (condition marked by fluid build-up in lungs), hepatic impairment or kidney problems.       

NIKORAN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking it.     

The most common side effects of taking NIKORAN 5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, skin flushing, nausea, vomiting, weakness and rapid or forceful heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NICOSTAR OD 10MG TABLET

NICOSTAR OD 10MG TABLET contains Nicorandil which belongs to the group of medicines called Potassium channel activators. It is used in adults to manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris who cannot take heart medicines called beta-blockers or calcium antagonists.    

Angina pectoris is a type of temporary chest pain or discomfort which occurs as a result of decreased blood flow to the heart muscle which is usually not a heart attack but a sign of increased risk for heart attack that is generally characterized by symptoms such as squeezing pressure, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest that can occur sudden or recur over time.    

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with NICOSTAR OD 10MG TABLET as it may reduce your blood pressure even more.       

NICOSTAR OD 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe low blood pressure, low blood volume, heart problems (such as cardiogenic shock, left ventricular failure with low filling pressure or cardiac decompensation).       

Before taking NICOSTAR OD 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have lung problems such as pulmonary oedema (condition marked by fluid build-up in lungs), hepatic impairment or kidney problems.       

NICOSTAR OD 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking it.     

The most common side effects of taking NICOSTAR OD 10MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, skin flushing, nausea, vomiting, weakness and rapid or forceful heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NICOSTAR 10 TABLET

NICOSTAR 10 TABLET contains Nicorandil which belongs to the group of medicines called Potassium channel activators. It is used in adults to manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris who cannot take heart medicines called beta-blockers or calcium antagonists.    

Angina pectoris is a type of temporary chest pain or discomfort which occurs as a result of decreased blood flow to the heart muscle which is usually not a heart attack but a sign of increased risk for heart attack that is generally characterized by symptoms such as squeezing pressure, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest that can occur sudden or recur over time.    

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with NICOSTAR 10 TABLET as it may reduce your blood pressure even more.       

NICOSTAR 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe low blood pressure, low blood volume, heart problems (such as cardiogenic shock, left ventricular failure with low filling pressure or cardiac decompensation).       

Before taking NICOSTAR 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have lung problems such as pulmonary oedema (condition marked by fluid build-up in lungs), hepatic impairment or kidney problems.       

NICOSTAR 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking it.     

The most common side effects of taking NICOSTAR 10 TABLET are headache, dizziness, skin flushing, nausea, vomiting, weakness and rapid or forceful heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of NICOSTAR 10 TABLET
To manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How NICOSTAR 10 TABLET Works

NICOSTAR 10 TABLET works by increasing blood flow through the heart vessels, leading to improved blood and oxygen supply to the heart muscle thus reducing the workload of the heart which results in reducing the frequency and severity of angina attacks.

name: Niglin CR 2.6mg Tablet 25'S
introduction:
Introduction About NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET

NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest.

Along with NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, manage weight and to improve your sleep pattern.

NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking the medicine. NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET
It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET Works

NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET

Always use NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition. Continue to take NIGLIN CR 2.6MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET contains Ranolazine, a medicine used in the management of chronic angina (chest pain). It works by improving blood flow to help the heart work more efficiently. It is especially helpful for individuals who continue to experience chest pain despite being on other heart medications or for those who cannot tolerate traditional options due to blood pressure or heart rate concern. 

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET works by improving the heart’s energy efficiency. Instead of lowering blood pressure or heart rate, it acts on specific sodium channels in the heart muscle to reduce excess sodium and calcium buildup. This allows the heart to relax better and function more efficiently, particularly during physical activity or emotional stress. 

Clinical studies have shown that patients taking Ranolazine experienced fewer angina attacks and better exercise tolerance, making it suitable for long-term use under medical supervision.

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET should be swallowed whole with water and can be taken with or without food. Patients with moderate to severe kidney problems or liver impairment should use this medicine with caution. Regular monitoring of kidney function may be advised for those with reduced kidney clearance (CrCl <60 mL/min).

Pregnant or breastfeeding women should use XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET only if clearly needed and prescribed by a doctor, as there is limited data on its safety in these populations. Common side effects include dizziness, constipation, nausea, and headache. If you experience severe symptoms like fainting, fast or irregular heartbeat  seek medical attention immediately. 

Always inform your healthcare provider about all the medications you are taking, as XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET can interact with certain drugs, including antifungals, antibiotics, and medications for seizures or heart rhythm problems.

mechanismOfAction:
How XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET Works
How does XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET work for chest pain?
XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET (Ranolazine) helps reduce chest pain (angina) by improving how your heart uses energy, especially during physical activity or stress. It controls certain signals in heart cells (called late sodium currents) that can make the heart overwork and cause discomfort.
By lowering stress on the heart, XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET reduces how often and how strongly chest pain happens, especially during activity. It works without slowing down your heart rate or lowering blood pressure, making it a good choice with other heart medications.
Understanding Ranolazine's Effect on Heart Function:
Ranolazine supports better heart function by helping heart muscles relax and work more smoothly. It reduces calcium overload in heart cells which helps the heart beat more efficiently without straining.
This makes it easier for your heart to work when oxygen is low like during exercise or emotional stress. Over time, Ranolazine improves exercise ability and reduces discomfort, helping you stay more active.

Unlike traditional angina treatments that focus primarily on lowering blood pressure or improving blood flow, XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET works by targeting the underlying mechanisms of heart muscle energy dysfunction.

Clinical studies have shown that XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET effectively reduces the number of angina attacks by improving the efficiency of the heart muscle and preventing the imbalance of sodium ions that contribute to angina.

For individuals with chronic angina, simple physical activities, like walking or climbing stairs, can trigger painful symptoms. XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET has been shown to improve exercise tolerance in angina patients by helping the heart use oxygen more efficiently, particularly during physical exertion.

Several clinical studies have demonstrated that XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET allows patients to engage in physical activities longer and with less discomfort. This makes it an invaluable medication for improving a patient's ability to participate in exercise and physical therapy.
By reducing the impact of exercise-induced angina, XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET supports an active lifestyle and enhances overall cardiovascular endurance.

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET has been shown to improve the quality of life for those suffering from chronic angina by minimizing the number of angina episodes, especially those triggered by physical activity or stress.

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET also plays a role in improving the overall function of the heart muscle by enhancing its energy efficiency. This unique action helps support heart function even during stressful conditions, reducing the risk of further complications related to angina.

In addition, XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET does not significantly lower blood pressure or heart rate, making it suitable for individuals who may have already been prescribed medications for these issues. Often used in combination with traditional angina medications to provide comprehensive heart support without unwanted side effects like dizziness or fatigue.

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET offers a unique advantage as it is considered safe for use in diabetic patients. Research indicates that XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET does not have significant adverse effects on blood sugar levels, which is a common concern with many medications used to manage heart conditions.

One of the most notable benefits of XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET is its ability to provide long-term relief from chronic angina. Unlike some medications that may lose their effectiveness with prolonged use, XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET maintains its efficacy, providing patients with lasting control over their symptoms.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET

Like all medicines XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them.

Common Side Effects of XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET
Nausea, vomiting
Constipation
Dizziness
Headache
Weakness
Neurological Effects and Dizziness from XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET (ranolazine) may cause neurological side effects in some patients due to its action on the central nervous system. These effects are generally mild, but in some cases may become bothersome or signal the need for medical review.

Reported neurological side effects include:
Dizziness or light-headedness, especially when standing
Headache
Lack of concentration or confusion
Tingling sensation (paresthesia)
Impact of XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET on Heart Rhythm and QT Interval

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET has been associated with QT interval prolongation, a change in heart rhythm that can increase the risk of irregular heartbeats (arrhythmias). This is a rare but potentially serious side effect that requires medical monitoring.

Cardiac-related side effects may include:
Palpitations (feeling your heart racing or skipping beats)
Abnormal ECG (electrocardiogram) findings
Fast or irregular heartbeat
Chest discomfort or shortness of breath
Effects of XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET on Sleep and Mental Clarity

Some patients may notice cognitive or sleep-related side effects while taking XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET. These effects are usually mild but can interfere with daily functioning in sensitive individuals.

Possible effects on mental clarity and sleep:

Insomnia or difficulty falling asleep
Vivid dreams or restlessness at night
Feeling mentally foggy or “out of it” during the day
Mood swings or irritability
When to Seek Medical Attention?

Stop taking XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Symptoms of angioedema or allergic reaction such as hives, swelling of the face, tongue or throat causing difficulty in breathing or swallowing
If you feel your heartbeat is abnormal, too fast or fluttering
Sleep disturbances or brain fog persist for more than a few days and impacts daily quality of life

warnings.details: XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed and if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus. There are limited human studies available on the use of Ranolazine during pregnancy. Animal studies have shown adverse effects at high doses. Always consult a doctor before starting Ranolazine if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant

It is unknown whether Ranolazine is excreted in human breast milk. Potential harm to the nursing infant cannot be ruled out. A decision should be made whether to discontinue breastfeeding or discontinue the drug, taking into account the importance of the medicine to the mother. Avoid use while breastfeeding unless prescribed with close monitoring

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, lightheadedness, faintness, blurred vision, confusion, hallucination, double vision and coordination problems after taking XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney impairment (creatinine clearance <30 mL/min). Increased risk of adverse effects due to accumulation of the drug in renal dysfunction. Renal function should be assessed before and during treatment, especially in elderly patients. Dose adjustment may be required; always follow the prescriber's instructions.

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET is not recommended in patients with moderate to severe liver dysfunction. The studies have shown that Ranolazine gets extensively metabolized in the liver hence Impaired function can lead to elevated drug levels and increased risk of side effects, especially QT prolongation.
Do not take XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET if you are allergic to Ranolazine or to lactose or other sugars or to any other ingredients of this medicine.

XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate to severe heart failure, abnormal ECG changes like QT prolongation or long QT syndrome. Contact your doctor before taking XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET
XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET
XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking XEMNOL SR 500 TABLET

name: ISONITRATE 20 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ISONITRATE 20 TABLET

ISONITRATE 20 TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

ISONITRATE 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking ISONITRATE 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). ISONITRATE 20 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking ISONITRATE 20 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Marked low blood pressure (systolic blood pressure ≤ 90 mmHg)
Severe anemia (low level of red blood cells)
Closed angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eye)
Conditions associated with raised pressure on the brain (following head trauma and cerebral haemorrhage)
Severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume)

Have hypothyroidism
Suffer from malnutrition
Have low body temperature (hypothermia)

introduction:
Introduction About NIKOS 5MG TABLET

NIKOS 5MG TABLET contains Nicorandil which belongs to the group of medicines called Potassium channel activators. It is used in adults to manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris who cannot take heart medicines called beta-blockers or calcium antagonists.    

Angina pectoris is a type of temporary chest pain or discomfort which occurs as a result of decreased blood flow to the heart muscle which is usually not a heart attack but a sign of increased risk for heart attack that is generally characterized by symptoms such as squeezing pressure, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest that can occur sudden or recur over time.    

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with NIKOS 5MG TABLET as it may reduce your blood pressure even more.       

NIKOS 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe low blood pressure, low blood volume, heart problems (such as cardiogenic shock, left ventricular failure with low filling pressure or cardiac decompensation).       

Before taking NIKOS 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have lung problems such as pulmonary oedema (condition marked by fluid build-up in lungs), hepatic impairment or kidney problems.       

NIKOS 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking it.     

The most common side effects of taking NIKOS 5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, skin flushing, nausea, vomiting, weakness and rapid or forceful heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIKOS 5MG TABLET
To manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How NIKOS 5MG TABLET Works

NIKOS 5MG TABLET works by increasing blood flow through the heart vessels, leading to improved blood and oxygen supply to the heart muscle thus reducing the workload of the heart which results in reducing the frequency and severity of angina attacks.
usageDetails:
How to use NIKOS 5MG TABLET

Take NIKOS 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Nikoran 2mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION

NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION contains Nicorandil which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianginal drugs. It is used in adults for the management of unstable angina. Angina pectoris is a pain syndrome due to imbalance in demand and supply of oxygen in a portion of the heart muscle.   

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION, as it may reduce your blood pressure even more.

Before receiving NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver or heart problems, dehydration or high blood pressure in lung vessels. NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women.

NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety data and it should be used with caution in elderly patients.

NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION may cause side effects such as headache, nausea, vomiting and upper abdominal discomfort. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: For management of unstable angina
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION
For management of unstable angina
mechanismOfAction:
How NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION Works

NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION works by increasing blood flow through the heart vessels, leading to improved blood and oxygen supply to the heart muscle and thus reducing workload of the heart.
usageDetails:
How to use NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION

NIKORAN 2MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: NITROBUZ 2.6 Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET

NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET contains Nitroglycerine that belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease.

Angina is a type of chest pain which is caused by reduced blood flow to the heart as a result of coronary artery disease. Symptoms are feeling pressure, squeezing, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest or a heavy weight is lying on the chest.

Along with NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET your doctor may advise you to make certain lifestyle changes such as quitting alcohol and smoking, eating a healthy diet, manage weight and to improve your sleep pattern.

NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases (hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy), anaemia, raised pressure in head, raised pressure in the eye (glaucoma), or are taking medicines to manage erectile dysfunction (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil.

NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases, underactive thyroid gland, low body temperature, malnourishment, abnormally low levels of oxygen in blood, very low blood pressure, low blood volume, disease of the blood vessels supplying the brain, or conditions that lower blood volume in the heart.

NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Take your doctor’s advice before taking the medicine. NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET are throbbing headache, spinning sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of energy. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET
It is used for management of angina pectoris due to coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET Works

NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET causes relaxation of smooth muscles within blood vessels which leads to relaxation and widening of blood vessels. This improves blood supply to the heart muscles. As a result, it helps to relieve chest pain and blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET

Always use NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Sublingual Tablet: Place NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET inside your mouth, below the tongue and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition. Continue to take NITROBUZ 2.6 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: IVADIN XR Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About IVADIN XR 10 TABLET

IVADIN XR 10 TABLET contains Ivabradine which belongs to the group of medicines called Hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel blockers. IVADIN XR 10 TABLET is used to manage symptomatic stable angina pectoris (chest pain) in adult patients who are intolerant/incapable to take heart medicines (such as beta blockers) and whose heart rate is over/equal to 70 beats per minute.

It is also used to manage chronic heart failure in adult patients whose heart rate is over/equal to 75 beats per minute which are used as a combination therapy with beta-blockers or in adult patients who are contraindicated to use beta blockers.

IVADIN XR 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to ivabradine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from very low blood pressure, heart problems (such as unstable angina, cardiogenic shock), severe kidney disease, and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking IVADIN XR 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate low blood pressure, chronic eye retinal disease, recent stroke (cerebral attack), heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), and/or moderate liver disease.

IVADIN XR 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking IVADIN XR 10 TABLET are brief moments of increased brightness (due to sudden changes in light intensity), slow heart rate, uncontrolled blood pressure, headache, dizziness, and/or blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How IVADIN XR 10 TABLET Works

IVADIN XR 10 TABLET works by reducing the heart rate which leads to low oxygen requirement of the heart resulting in improved blood supply throughout the body (with each hear beat) thus providing relief from angina pectoris and managing the occurrence of chronic heart failure in affected individuals

Tablet:

Take IVADIN XR 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place IVADIN XR 10 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

IVADIN XR 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Do not drive or operate any machines after taking IVADIN XR 10 TABLET since it may cause temporary blindness (due to sudden changes in light intensity) which may after your ability to concentrate while driving or operating machines.
IVADIN XR 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

IVADIN XR 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

IVADIN XR 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as slow resting heart rate (beats below 70/minute), cardiogenic shock, heart rhythm disorders (such as sick sinus syndrome, sino-atrial block, heart block), heavy heart attack, and/or severe heart failure. It should be used with caution in patients with other heart rhythm disorders (such as irregular heartbeat, palpitation, increase in chest pain), sustained atrial fibrillation, long QT syndrome, slow heartbeat (associated with signs such as tiredness, dizziness, shortness of breath), and/or bundle branch block (type of severe heart failure). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

IVADIN XR 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Suffer from very low blood pressure
Have unstable angina (a severe form of chest pain)

Had a recent stroke (cerebral attack)

Have chronic eye retinal disease

name: Nikoran OD 20mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NIKORAN OD

NIKORAN OD contains Nicorandil which belongs to the group of medicines called Potassium channel activators. It is used in adults to manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris who cannot take heart medicines called beta-blockers or calcium antagonists.    

Angina pectoris is a type of temporary chest pain or discomfort which occurs as a result of decreased blood flow to the heart muscle which is usually not a heart attack but a sign of increased risk for heart attack that is generally characterized by symptoms such as squeezing pressure, heaviness, tightness or pain in the chest that can occur sudden or recur over time.    

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with NIKORAN OD as it may reduce your blood pressure even more.       

NIKORAN OD is not recommended for use in patients with severe low blood pressure, low blood volume, heart problems (such as cardiogenic shock, left ventricular failure with low filling pressure or cardiac decompensation).       

Before taking NIKORAN OD, inform your doctor if you have lung problems such as pulmonary oedema (condition marked by fluid build-up in lungs), hepatic impairment or kidney problems.       

NIKORAN OD is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking it.     

The most common side effects of taking NIKORAN OD are headache, dizziness, skin flushing, nausea, vomiting, weakness and rapid or forceful heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIKORAN OD
To manage and reduce painful signs of angina pectoris in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How NIKORAN OD Works

NIKORAN OD works by increasing blood flow through the heart vessels, leading to improved blood and oxygen supply to the heart muscle thus reducing the workload of the heart which results in reducing the frequency and severity of angina attacks.

Take NIKORAN OD as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have glucose-6 phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency (a genetic condition)

Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Suffer from very low blood pressure
Have unstable angina (a severe form of chest pain)

Had a recent stroke (cerebral attack)
Suffer from mild to moderate low blood pressure (after change in antihypertensive management)
Have chronic eye retinal disease

IVABEAT OD 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Use in Geriatrics:

IVABEAT OD 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About TIDILAN INJECTION

TIDILAN INJECTION contains Isoxsuprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used in the management of premature labor (when the uterus contraction starts for birth too early than usual) or threatened abortion, cerebral vascular insufficiency (poor blood flow to the brain) and arteriosclerosis obliterans (hardening of the arteries).

TIDILAN INJECTION is also used to manage Buerger's disease (blood vessels become inflamed, swell and can become blocked with blood clots) and Raynaud’s phenomenon (decreased blood flow to the nose, ears, fingers, toes, nipples or knees). You should avoid participating in any stressful or heavy activities in order to manage premature labor.

Avoid smoking tobacco during TIDILAN INJECTION management as it can further constrict your blood vessels. TIDILAN INJECTION should not be used immediately postpartum (after delivering a baby) or if you have a bleeding disorder, heart disease, severe anemia, premature detachment of the placenta and premature labor if there is infection.

TIDILAN INJECTION should be used in pregnant women only if the potential benefits outweigh the potential risks to mother and her baby. There are no reports of problems with TIDILAN INJECTION use in breastfeeding babies but consult your doctor before receiving it.

TIDILAN INJECTION is not recommended for use in children. The most common side effects of receiving TIDILAN INJECTION are fast heartbeat and vomiting. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

introduction:
Introduction About NITROFIX 20MG TABLET

NITROFIX 20MG TABLET contains Isosorbide Mononitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nitrate vasodilators. It is used to manage angina pectoris and heart failure (when your heart cannot pump enough blood around the body). Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused when your heart muscle does not get enough blood supply. The pain is severe and crushing and it is characterized by feeling of pressure and suffocation, behind the breastbone.

Your doctor may advise you to follow lifestyle changes such as diet changes (taking foods low in fat, salt or sugar) and do regular mild exercises to achieve better results during management with this medicine.           

NITROFIX 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as circulatory collapse, cardiogenic shock, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart), severe anemia (low-level of red blood cells) and severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).

Before taking NITROFIX 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney problems, hypothyroidism and low body temperature (hypothermia). NITROFIX 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  The common side effects of taking NITROFIX 20MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NITROFIX 20MG TABLET Works

NITROFIX 20MG TABLET helps to relax the blood vessels and muscles of the heart, which causes the space inside the blood vessels to widen. This helps to ease the flow of blood in the blood vessels of the heart and provides relief from the pain associated with blockage of vessels as seen in angina.
usageDetails:

Take NITROFIX 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of NITROFIX 20MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NITROFIX 20MG TABLET because it might increase the risk of dizziness and fainting due to reduction in blood pressure.

NITROFIX 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe problems in the liver. Consult your doctor before taking NITROFIX 20MG TABLET.
Do not take NITROFIX 20MG TABLET if you are allergic to isosorbide mononitrate or other nitrates (such as isosorbide dinitrate)

NITROFIX 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with circulatory collapse or shock, cardiogenic shock, acute myocardial infarction with low left ventricular filling pressure, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (a thickened heart muscle), constrictive pericarditis (an inflammation of the heart sac), cardiac tamponade (accumulation of fluid around the heart) and aortic/mitral valve stenosis (narrowing of heart valves). It should be used with caution in patients with a recent history of myocardial infarction (heart attack). Consult your doctor before taking NITROFIX 20MG TABLET.

Others

NITROFIX 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Marked low blood pressure (systolic blood pressure ≤ 90 mmHg)
Severe anemia (low level of red blood cells)
Closed angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eye)
Conditions associated with raised pressure on the brain (following head trauma and cerebral haemorrhage)
Severe hypovolemia (decreased blood volume)

Before taking NITROFIX 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hypothyroidism
Suffer from malnutrition
Have low body temperature (hypothermia)

Use in Pediatrics

NITROFIX 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety and effectiveness. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics
NITROFIX 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About CHANNEL 30MG TABLET

CHANNEL 30MG TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with CHANNEL 30MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking CHANNEL 30MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking CHANNEL 30MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

CHANNEL 30MG TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking CHANNEL 30MG TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CHANNEL 30MG TABLET Works

CHANNEL 30MG TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use CHANNEL 30MG TABLET

Take CHANNEL 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking CHANNEL 30MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.
